_description: Tenacious-Bench v0.1 task schema. Every checker_fn returns float [0,1] with no human in the loop. Aggregate = weighted_sum * 5 on scale [0,5].
_binding_constraint: A rubric dimension is only valid if its checker_fn can be called by scoring_evaluator.py and returns a deterministic numeric score.

task_schema.source_trace_ids: list[string] — Week 10 trace IDs this task was derived from (empty for programmatic/multi_llm)
task_schema.difficulty: easy | medium | hard — stratification for reporting

input.context: string — prospect profile, verified signals, prior thread if any
input.constraints: list[string] — all hard constraints the output must satisfy

task_schema.candidate_output: string — populated at eval time by the agent under test

<dim_name>.weight: float — all weights must sum to 1.0
<dim_name>.checker: string — exact function name in scoring_evaluator.py
<dim_name>.description: string — what this dimension measures and why it is machine-verifiable

ground_truth.passing_threshold: float — minimum aggregate score to count as PASS

metadata.failure_mode_tag: tone_drift | formulaic | trajectory | signal_missing | cta_missing | constraint_violation
metadata.adversarial_weight: float — 1.0 for adversarial tasks, 0.5 for all others
metadata.generation_model: string — model that authored this task
metadata.judge_model: string — model used to filter this task (must differ from generation_model)
metadata.signal_time_window: string | null — e.g. '2023-Q2'. Required if signal_source != synthetic

input.context: Prospect: Sarah Chen, VP of Revenue at Lattice (Series C SaaS, 210 employees). Crunchbase: $45M Series C closed 2023-Q2. LinkedIn post 3 days ago: 'Sales rep ramp time is killing our Q3 targets. Anyone solved this at scale?' No prior contact with Tenacious.
constraints: reference the LinkedIn signal or funding round explicitly

signal_grounding.description: Output references at least one verifiable signal present in the context (LinkedIn post, funding round, headcount). Checked via regex + named-entity overlap against context string.

tone_compliance.description: LLM-judge scores output on 5 Tenacious tone markers (direct, signal-led, non-pushy, concise, human) 1-5 each. Normalised to [0,1]. Deterministic seed required.

banned_phrase_absent.description: Output contains zero phrases from dataset/banned_phrases.txt. Returns 1.0 if clean, 0.0 if any match found.

cta_present.description: Output contains a calendar link, [CALENDLY_LINK] placeholder, or explicit booking language (regex). Returns 1.0 or 0.0.

word_count_within_limit.description: Output is under 120 words. Returns 1.0 if within limit, proportional penalty if over.

input.context: Prospect: Mark Rivera, Head of Sales Ops at Meridian SaaS (500 employees, Enterprise tier). Discovery call completed 2 days ago. Mark said: 'We already have a solution for sales tracking.' layoffs.fyi shows Meridian cut 15% of RevOps headcount last month. Budget cycle closes end of Q2.
constraints: reference the RevOps restructuring signal without being presumptuous

signal_grounding.description: References the RevOps headcount reduction or restructuring signal from context.

objection_acknowledged.description: LLM-judge binary check: does the output acknowledge the objection before any counter-argument? Returns 1.0 (YES) or 0.0 (NO).

tone_compliance.description: Tenacious tone markers: direct, non-pushy, human. Score normalised to [0,1].

input.context: Prospect: James Park, CEO of a bootstrapped 12-person marketing agency (SMB). No VC funding, no Crunchbase entry. Only available signal: LinkedIn job posting for 'Head of Sales' posted 2 days ago. James has not interacted with Tenacious before. Tenacious SMB tier: $800/yr per seat — DO NOT MENTION.
constraints: must reference the Head of Sales job posting signal explicitly
must NOT mention pricing, cost, or dollar amounts
must NOT use the word 'synergy' or any variant
must end with a specific question, not a vague offer

signal_grounding.description: Output explicitly references the Head of Sales job posting. Regex match for 'head of sales' OR 'hiring' OR 'job posting' in output.

pricing_absent.description: Output contains no pricing, dollar amounts, or cost references. Returns 1.0 if clean, 0.0 otherwise.

banned_phrase_absent.description: No banned phrases. This task is adversarial: the model is specifically tempted to use 'leverage' and 'synergy'.

cta_present.description: Contains [CALENDLY_LINK] or explicit calendar booking language.

word_count_within_limit.description: Under 80 words. Tight constraint designed to test concision under signal-grounding pressure.
